query:
SELECT artist AS "artist!", release AS "release!"
                FROM (
                    SELECT artist, release,
                           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY artist ORDER BY release) AS rn
                    FROM artist_release
                    WHERE artist = ANY($1)
                      AND ($2::int IS NULL OR release > $2)
                ) ranked
                WHERE rn <= $3
                ORDER BY artist, release
